name: Soprano Ice laser

lead: Soprano Ice is a hair-removal laser line from Alma Lasers, marketed as a more comfortable option. The Soprano Ice Platinum combines 755, 810 and 1064 nm wavelengths in one device to reduce facial and body hair across a range of skin types.

Like other hair-removal lasers, it targets melanin in hair follicles by selective photothermolysis, with cooling to protect the skin. A 2021 paper in the Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology reported on the Platinum for hair reduction in Fitzpatrick skin types IV to V.

paras: Treatment is done in a clinic over a series of sessions spaced weeks apart. Combining wavelengths is described as an approach to treat a range of skin types. Users and clinics promote it for lower discomfort, though specific comparisons with other devices were not found.

General laser hair-removal risks apply: redness, swelling, burns and pigment changes. Specific data on pain reduction versus other devices were not found. Results are a reduction in hair rather than guaranteed removal.

chain: Hair growth slows with lower pain
angle.text: Soprano Ice uses three wavelengths, 755, 810 and 1064 nm, to heat follicles so hair growth slows with lower discomfort, leaving smoother, less hairy skin. One 2021 study evaluated the Platinum model in skin types IV to V.

lead: The Soprano Ice Platinum from Alma Lasers (Germany) is a hair-removal laser that emits a combination of three wavelengths, 755, 810 and 1064 nm, in a single device. [1]

A 2021 paper in the Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology reported on its efficacy and safety for hair reduction in Fitzpatrick skin types IV to V. [1] The study background notes that laser hair reduction is among the most common laser procedures in dermatology and that ruby, alexandrite, diode and Nd:YAG systems exist. [1]

paras: A study of the Soprano Ice Platinum in skin types IV to V was published in 2021. [1] No other studies were found, and numerical results are not reported here.
The device is described as a pain-reduced hair-removal system; no published trial comparing its pain levels with other systems was found.
